key_insight: Machine learning accelerates the modeling of thermodynamic stability in hybrid perovskite alloys.
engineering_relevance: This approach enhances the design and development of stable perovskite solar cells.
method: Utilized a two-level machine learning strategy for phase stability analysis.
Employed graph neural network interatomic potentials for efficient structure relaxation.
Implemented secondary ML models for direct energy prediction from unrelaxed structures.
evidence_signal: Results showed narrower stable composition regions for Sn-based systems compared to Pb-based systems.
watch_item: The model reveals limited options for compositional engineering, particularly in the Sn-based system.
paper_title: Charting the thermodynamic stability of hybrid perovskite alloys with machine learning
